verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions serverless indexes in the multitenancy and backup guides, and a community post praises the free tier. None of it documents usage-based billing, per-unit costs (e.g., per read/write/storage unit), or pricing transparency. Serverless index architecture is an adjacent feature, not evidence of the pricing model the story asks about.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters
